label: عبير — سعودية
ref_text: عند الانتهاء من مساعدتك، سيتم تحويل مكالمتكم لتقييم مدى رضاكم
source: tts-05172026/cloneVoice/abeer_ref_6s.wav (cut from 'Saudi Voice Artist Abeer Female Audio Sample.wav')
notes: Abeer, a Saudi female voice artist: a real recording, cut from her demo sample, which no model here trained on (the clone_abeer voice of the Saudi benchmark). The clip is a formal phone-menu line and the clone follows it: cloned with the omnivoice_najdi model it scores among the highest UTMOS of the built-in voices (3.65 on 20 Najdi lines) and keeps part of her timbre (similarity to her sample 0.71), while her Najdi lines come out only partly Gulf (P(Gulf) 0.63 with ars, 0.54 with arb).

language_check.model: najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250, 20 held-out Najdi lines and 20 held-out MSA lines, each code
